-- BrainrotCatalog.luau -- BRAINROT NUSANTARA (roblox-brainrot-01)
-- The cast: 12 original Nusantara brainrot characters on a 6-tier ladder,
-- 2 characters per tier, plus the mutation table.
-- Every character has a silhouette key (how ConveyorService builds its
-- parts-based model) and an animation key (its signature idle animation).
-- Written for the foundation phase (17 Nov 2026).

local BrainrotCatalog = {}

-- Tiers, weakest first. weight = spawn share out of 100.
BrainrotCatalog.TIERS = {
	{ name = "Common", weight = 40, color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200) },
	{ name = "Rare", weight = 25, color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255) },
	{ name = "Epic", weight = 15, color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 90, 255) },
	{ name = "Legendary", weight = 10, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40) },
	{ name = "Mythic", weight = 6, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 120) },
	{ name = "Brainrot God", weight = 4, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0) },
}

-- Mutations: rolled on spawn, visual + rate multiplier.
-- Roll 1-100: 1 = Rainbow, 2-4 = Diamond, 5-14 = Gold, else none.
BrainrotCatalog.MUTATIONS = {
	{ name = "Gold", multiplier = 2, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60) },
	{ name = "Diamond", multiplier = 5, color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 220, 255) },
	{ name = "Rainbow", multiplier = 10, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 200) },
}

-- price = rate x 10, so the ladder is readable: a character pays for
-- itself in 10 seconds of income, and the next tier is always the goal.
BrainrotCatalog.CHARACTERS = {
	-- Common
	{ id = "tung_tung_sahur", name = "Tung Tung Sahur", tier = 1, rate = 5, price = 50,
		silhouette = "kentongan", animation = "beat", color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 50),
		blurb = "Kentongan sahur yang tidak pernah tidur." },
	{ id = "es_teh_manis", name = "Es Teh Manis", tier = 1, rate = 8, price = 80,
		silhouette = "es_teh", animation = "slosh", color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 140, 40),
		blurb = "Segelas es teh, es batunya masih berenang." },
	-- Rare
	{ id = "kambing_garut", name = "Kambing Garut", tier = 2, rate = 25, price = 250,
		silhouette = "kambing", animation = "trot", color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
		blurb = "Kambing aduan, tanduknya juara." },
	{ id = "ondel_ondel", name = "Ondel-Ondel", tier = 2, rate = 40, price = 400,
		silhouette = "ondel", animation = "sway", color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40),
		blurb = "Boneka raksasa Betawi, goyangnya menular." },
	-- Epic
	{ id = "nasi_padang", name = "Nasi Padang", tier = 3, rate = 90, price = 900,
		silhouette = "nasi_padang", animation = "steam", color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 210, 90),
		blurb = "Sepiring nasi, lauknya tidak pernah habis." },
	{ id = "bajaj_biru", name = "Bajaj Biru", tier = 3, rate = 140, price = 1400,
		silhouette = "bajaj", animation = "drive", color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 255),
		blurb = "Bajaj ngebut, knalpotnya ngebul." },
	-- Legendary
	{ id = "kuntilanak", name = "Kuntilanak", tier = 4, rate = 300, price = 3000,
		silhouette = "kuntilanak", animation = "float", color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245),
		blurb = "Hantu putih yang melayang, tidak pernah menyentuh tanah." },
	{ id = "tuyul_kantong", name = "Tuyul Kantong", tier = 4, rate = 450, price = 4500,
		silhouette = "tuyul", animation = "hop", color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 180, 110),
		blurb = "Bocah kecil bawa kantong uang." },
	-- Mythic
	{ id = "garuda_emas", name = "Garuda Emas", tier = 5, rate = 900, price = 9000,
		silhouette = "garuda", animation = "flap", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40),
		blurb = "Garuda emas, sayapnya berkilau." },
	{ id = "komodo_raja", name = "Komodo Raja", tier = 5, rate = 1400, price = 14000,
		silhouette = "komodo", animation = "crawl", color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 140, 100),
		blurb = "Raja komodo, ekornya menyapu lantai." },
	-- Brainrot God
	{ id = "sang_hyang_tung_tung", name = "Sang Hyang Tung Tung", tier = 6, rate = 5000, price = 50000,
		silhouette = "sang_hyang", animation = "glow", color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 140, 60),
		blurb = "Kentongan para dewa, bermahkota emas." },
	{ id = "nusantara_prime", name = "Nusantara Prime", tier = 6, rate = 10000, price = 100000,
		silhouette = "nusantara_prime", animation = "stance", color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 50),
		blurb = "Gabungan seluruh nusantara dalam satu wujud." },
}

function BrainrotCatalog.getCharacter(id)
	for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotCatalog.CHARACTERS) do
		if entry.id == id then
			return entry
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function BrainrotCatalog.getTier(tierIndex)
	return BrainrotCatalog.TIERS[tierIndex]
end

function BrainrotCatalog.getTierName(tierIndex)
	local tier = BrainrotCatalog.TIERS[tierIndex]
	if tier then
		return tier.name
	end
	return "Common"
end

-- Weighted tier roll: 1-100 against the tier weights.
function BrainrotCatalog.rollTier()
	local roll = math.random(1, 100)
	local running = 0
	for i, tier in ipairs(BrainrotCatalog.TIERS) do
		running = running + tier.weight
		if roll <= running then
			return i
		end
	end
	return 1
end

-- Pick a random character of a tier (2 per tier).
function BrainrotCatalog.rollCharacter()
	local tier = BrainrotCatalog.rollTier()
	local pool = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(BrainrotCatalog.CHARACTERS) do
		if entry.tier == tier then
			table.insert(pool, entry)
		end
	end
	return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
end

-- Mutation roll: 1% Rainbow, 3% Diamond, 10% Gold, else none.
function BrainrotCatalog.rollMutation()
	local roll = math.random(1, 100)
	if roll <= 1 then
		return BrainrotCatalog.MUTATIONS[3]
	elseif roll <= 4 then
		return BrainrotCatalog.MUTATIONS[2]
	elseif roll <= 14 then
		return BrainrotCatalog.MUTATIONS[1]
	end
	return nil
end

function BrainrotCatalog.getMutation(name)
	if name == nil then
		return nil
	end
	for _, mutation in ipairs(BrainrotCatalog.MUTATIONS) do
		if mutation.name == name then
			return mutation
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Income per second of one brainrot, mutation included.
function BrainrotCatalog.getRate(entry, mutation)
	local mult = 1
	if mutation ~= nil then
		mult = mutation.multiplier
	end
	return entry.rate * mult
end

return BrainrotCatalog

-- Main.server.luau -- BRAINROT NUSANTARA (roblox-brainrot-01)
-- Server entry: wires the services together. State lives in BrainrotData,
-- the conveyor walks the cast, bases are built and assigned here, and
-- the economy (earn ticks, buy/carry/place, sell, rebirth) runs through
-- the Remotes folder in ReplicatedStorage.
-- Written for the foundation phase (17 Nov 2026); economy wired in
-- phase 2 (18 Nov 2026).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local BrainrotData = require(script:WaitForChild("services"):WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))
local BaseService = require(script:WaitForChild("services"):WaitForChild("BaseService"))
local ConveyorService = require(script:WaitForChild("services"):WaitForChild("ConveyorService"))
local EconomyService = require(script:WaitForChild("services"):WaitForChild("EconomyService"))
local StealService = require(script:WaitForChild("services"):WaitForChild("StealService"))
local EventService = require(script:WaitForChild("services"):WaitForChild("EventService"))

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

BrainrotData.init()
BaseService.init()
ConveyorService.init()
EconomyService.init(remotes)
StealService.init(remotes)
EventService.init(remotes)

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	BrainrotData.addPlayer(player)
	BaseService.assignBaseToPlayer(player)
	-- The client also asks for state with GetState on start; this push
	-- covers the case where it is already listening.
	EconomyService.sendState(player)
end

-- Players already in the game when this script runs (Studio Play Solo).
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	-- Phase 3 disconnect-while-carrying rule: the carried brainrot
	-- returns to the conveyor (or becomes a crate if the event already
	-- marked it washing). It never vanishes.
	EconomyService.releaseCarried(player)
	BrainrotData.removePlayer(player)
end)

print("[BRAINROT NUSANTARA] Server ready -- phase 3 (Pasar Tumpah, steal, lock, slap).")

```lua
-- BaseService.luau -- BRAINROT NUSANTARA (roblox-brainrot-01)
-- Bases: one job. Clones the BaseTemplate (ServerStorage) into 8 base
-- platforms in a ring around the plaza, assigns one to each player,
-- owns the slots a brainrot is placed on.
-- Written for the foundation phase (17 Nov 2026).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local BrainrotData = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("BrainrotData"))

local BaseService = {}

local basesFolder = nil
local baseModels = {}

-- A base is rotated so its sign sits on the far side from the plaza
-- centre, facing in: yaw = -angle - 90 degrees.
local function ringCFrame(index)
	local angle = (index - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / Config.BASE_COUNT)
	local x = math.cos(angle) * Config.BASE_RING_RADIUS
	local z = math.sin(angle) * Config.BASE_RING_RADIUS
	return CFrame.new(x, 0, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, -angle - math.pi / 2, 0)
end

local function addSignLabel(model, baseId)
	local sign = model:FindFirstChild("SignBoard")
	if sign == nil then
		return
	end
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "BaseSign"
	gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 60)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Parent = sign
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "OwnerLabel"
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
	label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.Text = "Base " .. baseId .. "\n(kosong)"
	label.Parent = gui
end

function BaseService.init()
	basesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	basesFolder.Name = "Bases"
	basesFolder.Parent = Workspace
	local template = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("BaseTemplate")
	for i = 1, Config.BASE_COUNT do
		local model = template:Clone()
		model.Name = "Base" .. i
		model:PivotTo(ringCFrame(i))
		local platform = model:FindFirstChild("Platform")
		if platform ~= nil then
			platform.Color = Config.BASE_COLORS[i]
		end
		model.Parent = basesFolder
		baseModels[i] = model
		BrainrotData.registerBase(i, model)
		addSignLabel(model, i)
	end
end

function BaseService.getBaseModel(baseId)
	return baseModels[baseId]
end

-- First free base goes to the player. Returns the base id, or nil.
function BaseService.assignBaseToPlayer(player)
	for i = 1, Config.BASE_COUNT do
		local base = BrainrotData.getBase(i)
		if base ~= nil and base.owner == nil then
			if BrainrotData.assignBase(player, i) then
				BaseService.setSignOwner(i, player.Name)
				return i
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function BaseService.setSignOwner(baseId, ownerName)
	local model = baseModels[baseId]
	if model == nil then
		return
	end
	local sign = model:FindFirstChild("SignBoard")
	if sign == nil then
		return
	end
	local gui = sign:FindFirstChild("BaseSign")
	if gui == nil then
		return
	end
	local label = gui:FindFirstChild("OwnerLabel")
	if label ~= nil then
		label.Text = "Base " .. baseId .. "\n" .. ownerName
	end
end

-- World CFrame of a slot pad, lifted so a placed brainrot stands on it.
function BaseService.getSlotCFrame(baseId, slotIndex)
	local model = baseModels[baseId]
	if model == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local pad = model:FindFirstChild("Slot" .. slotIndex)
	if pad == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return pad.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0)
end

-- Place a carried brainrot on a slot: bookkeeping in BrainrotData, then
-- move its model onto the pad. Called by EconomyService in phase 2.
function BaseService.placeBrainrot(player, uid, slotIndex)
	local state = BrainrotData.getPlayer(player)
	if state == nil then
		return false
	end
	local baseId = state.baseId
	if baseId == nil then
		return false
	end
	local record = BrainrotData.getBrainrot(uid)
	if record == nil or record.model == nil then
		return false
	end
	local slotCFrame = BaseService.getSlotCFrame(baseId, slotIndex)
	if slotCFrame == nil then
		return false
	end
	if not BrainrotData.placeBrainrot(player, uid, slotIndex) then
		return false
	end
	-- Placed models live under their base, not the conveyor folder, so
	-- the client's buy scan never mistakes them for conveyor stock.
	record.model.Parent = baseModels[baseId]
	record.model:PivotTo(slotCFrame)
	return true
end

-- Free a slot when its brainrot leaves (steal / sell / rebirth).
function BaseService.clearSlot(uid)
	return BrainrotData.unplaceBrainrot(uid)
end

-- Phase 3: show a base lock on its sign ("Base 3\nDen\n🔒 TERKUNCI").
-- StealService calls this when a lock starts and when it expires.
function BaseService.setLockVisual(baseId, locked)
	local model = baseModels[baseId]
	if model == nil then
		return
	end
	local sign = model:FindFirstChild("SignBoard")
	if sign == nil then
		return
	end
	local gui = sign:FindFirstChild("BaseSign")
	if gui == nil then
		return
	end
	local label = gui:FindFirstChild("OwnerLabel")
	if label == nil then
		return
	end
	local text = label.Text
	if locked then
		if string.find(text, "TERKUNCI", 1, true) == nil then
			label.Text = text .. "\n🔒 TERKUNCI"
		end
	else
		label.Text = string.gsub(text, "\n🔒 TERKUNCI", "")
	end
end

return BaseService
```

-- BrainrotData.luau -- BRAINROT NUSANTARA (roblox-brainrot-01)
-- Single source of state (judge criterion 5): players, bases, owned
-- brainrots, cash, multipliers. Every other service reads and writes
-- through this module, never through its own copies.
-- Written for the foundation phase (17 Nov 2026). Minimal logic: structure
-- + API. Economy (earn ticks, buy/sell), steal and the event write through
-- these same functions in later phases.
--
-- Brainrot states: "conveyor" (walking the bridge), "carried" (a player
-- is holding it), "placed" (earning on a base slot), "washing" (marked
-- by Pasar Tumpah, about to become a crate — transient, owned by the
-- event), "crate" (washed away, waiting in the scramble zone), "gone"
-- (despawned). One brainrot is ever in exactly one state: carried
-- brainrots are a single ownership state, never duplicated between
-- conveyor and crate.

local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local BrainrotCatalog = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("BrainrotCatalog"))

local BrainrotData = {}

local players = {}
local bases = {}
local brainrots = {}
local nextBrainrotId = 1

function BrainrotData.init()
	players = {}
	bases = {}
	brainrots = {}
	nextBrainrotId = 1
end

-- Players ---------------------------------------------------------------

function BrainrotData.addPlayer(player)
	players[player] = {
		cash = Config.START_CASH,
		multiplier = 1,
		rebirths = 0,
		baseId = nil,
		carrying = nil,
		brainrots = {},
	}
end

function BrainrotData.removePlayer(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if state ~= nil and state.carrying ~= nil then
		-- Defensive last resort only: Main.server calls
		-- EconomyService.releaseCarried first, which returns the
		-- carried brainrot to the conveyor (or leaves it to the event
		-- when it is washing). If we ever get here with a carried
		-- brainrot, it is not washing, so destroy it rather than leak.
		local carried = brainrots[state.carrying]
		if carried ~= nil then
			if carried.washPending then
				-- The event owns it; it becomes a crate, never vanishes.
				carried.owner = nil
			else
				carried.state = "gone"
				carried.owner = nil
				if carried.model ~= nil then
					carried.model:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	players[player] = nil
end

function BrainrotData.getPlayer(player)
	return players[player]
end

function BrainrotData.getCash(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if state == nil then
		return 0
	end
	return state.cash
end

function BrainrotData.addCash(player, amount)
	local state = players[player]
	if state == nil then
		return
	end
	state.cash = state.cash + amount
end

-- Returns true and deducts, or false when the player cannot afford it.
function BrainrotData.spendCash(player, amount)
	local state = players[player]
	if state == nil then
		return false
	end
	if state.cash < amount then
		return false
	end
	state.cash = state.cash - amount
	return true
end

function BrainrotData.getMultiplier(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if state == nil then
		return 1
	end
	return state.multiplier
end

function BrainrotData.addRebirth(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if state == nil then
		return
	end
	state.rebirths = state.rebirths + 1
	state.multiplier = state.multiplier * Config.REBIRTH_MULTIPLIER
end

-- Bases -----------------------------------------------------------------

function BrainrotData.registerBase(baseId, model)
	bases[baseId] = {
		model = model,
		owner = nil,
		slots = {},
		level = 0,
	}
	for i = 1, Config.BASE_SLOTS do
		bases[baseId].slots[i] = nil
	end
end

function BrainrotData.getBase(baseId)
	return bases[baseId]
end

function BrainrotData.assignBase(player, baseId)
	local state = players[player]
	local base = bases[baseId]
	if state == nil or base == nil then
		return false
	end
	if base.owner ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	base.owner = player
	state.baseId = baseId
	return true
end

function BrainrotData.getBaseForPlayer(player)
	local state = players[player]
	if state == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return state.baseId
end

function BrainrotData.getFreeSlot(baseId)
	local base = bases[baseId]
	if base == nil then
		return nil
	end
	for i = 1, Config.BASE_SLOTS do
		if base.slots[i] == nil then
			return i
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Brainrots --------------------------------------------------------------

function BrainrotData.createBrainrot(catalogId, mutationName)
	local entry = BrainrotCatalog.getCharacter(catalogId)
	if entry == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local mutation = BrainrotCatalog.getMutation(mutationName)
	local uid = nextBrainrotId
	nextBrainrotId = nextBrainrotId + 1
	local record = {
		uid = uid,
		catalogId = catalogId,
		name = entry.name,
		tier = entry.tier,
		rate = entry.rate,
		mutation = mutationName,
		mutationMult = 1,
		state = "conveyor",
		owner = nil,
		baseId = nil,
		slotIndex = nil,
		model = nil,
	}
	if mutation ~= nil then
		record.mutationMult = mutation.multiplier
	end
	brainrots[uid] = record
	return record
end

function BrainrotData.getBrainrot(uid)
	return brainrots[uid]
end

function BrainrotData.setBrainrotState(uid, state)
	local record = brainrots[uid]
	if record == nil then
		return
	end
	record.state = state
end

function BrainrotData.setBrainrotModel(uid, model)
	local record = brainrots[uid]
	if record == nil then
		return
	end

	reversed = value

		pathFinish = Config.CONVEYOR_START

		pathStart = Config.CONVEYOR_START

	if conveyor ~= nil then
		local spawnBeam = conveyor:FindFirstChild("SpawnBeam")
		local exitBeam = conveyor:FindFirstChild("ExitBeam")
		if spawnBeam ~= nil and exitBeam ~= nil then
			local pos = spawnBeam.Position
			spawnBeam.Position = exitBeam.Position
			exitBeam.Position = pos

		local pairs = {

		for _, pair in ipairs(pairs) do
			local a = conveyor:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
			local b = conveyor:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
			if a ~= nil and b ~= nil then
				local pos = a.Position
				a.Position = b.Position
				b.Position = pos

-- by leaving returns to the start of the bridge and walks again — it
-- never vanishes. The record and model come back exactly as they were.
function ConveyorService.returnToConveyor(uid)
	local record = BrainrotData.getBrainrot(uid)
	if record == nil or record.model == nil then
		return false
	end
	if active[uid] ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	record.state = "conveyor"
	record.owner = nil
	record.washPending = false
	record.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pathStart))
	record.model.Parent = conveyorFolder
	active[uid] = {
		uid = uid,
		model = record.model,
		entry = BrainrotCatalog.getCharacter(record.catalogId),
		distance = 0,
		animT = math.random() * 10,
	}
	return true
end

local function despawnBrainrot(uid)
	local item = active[uid]
	if item == nil then
		return
	end
	active[uid] = nil
	BrainrotData.setBrainrotState(uid, "gone")
	if item.model ~= nil then
		item.model:Destroy()
	end
end

local function updateConveyor(dt)
	animClock = animClock + dt
	if not paused then
		spawnTimer = spawnTimer + dt
		if spawnTimer >= Config.SPAWN_INTERVAL then
			spawnTimer = 0
			ConveyorService.spawnBrainrot()
		end
	end
	local path = pathFinish - pathStart
	local pathLength = path.Magnitude
	for uid, item in pairs(active) do
		item.distance = item.distance + Config.CONVEYOR_SPEED * dt
		item.animT = item.animT + dt
		local progress = item.distance / pathLength
		if progress >= 1 then
			despawnBrainrot(uid)
		else
			local position = pathStart + path * progress
			item.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
			ConveyorService.animateModel(item.model, item.entry, item.animT)
		end
	end
end

	conveyorFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	conveyorFolder.Name = "ConveyorBrainrots"
	conveyorFolder.Parent = Workspace
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(updateConveyor)
end

-- Economy: one job. Earn ticks, buy / carry / place, sell, rebirth.
-- All server-authoritative: the client only asks through RemoteFunctions,

-- and every change goes through BrainrotData. The server also pushes the

-- after every change and once per earn tick.
-- Written for phase 2 (18 Nov 2026).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local BrainrotCatalog = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("BrainrotCatalog"))

local ConveyorService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ConveyorService"))

local EconomyService = {}

-- Sell returns half the catalog price.
local SELL_FRACTION = 0.5
-- Server-side distance checks (client only offers nearer targets; the
-- extra margin absorbs lag). A player teleporting across the map cannot
-- buy or place from afar.
local BUY_DISTANCE = 20
local PLACE_DISTANCE = 20
local CARRY_HEIGHT = 3.2

local remotes = nil
local carriedAnims = {}
local placedAnims = {}
-- Carried brainrots live in their own folder, not under
-- ConveyorBrainrots: the client's buy scan only looks at the conveyor
-- folder, so a carried brainrot never shows up as buyable.
local carriedFolder = nil

-- State payload sent to one player's HUD. Never computed on the client.
function EconomyService.getState(player)
	local state = BrainrotData.getPlayer(player)
	if state == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local owned = {}
	for _, uid in ipairs(state.brainrots) do
		local record = BrainrotData.getBrainrot(uid)
		if record ~= nil and record.state == "placed" then
			local entry = BrainrotCatalog.getCharacter(record.catalogId)
			local tier = BrainrotCatalog.getTier(record.tier)
			table.insert(owned, {
				uid = uid,
				name = record.name,
				tier = BrainrotCatalog.getTierName(record.tier),
				tierColor = tier.color,
				rate = record.rate * record.mutationMult,
				mutation = record.mutation,
				slotIndex = record.slotIndex,
				sellPrice = math.floor(entry.price * SELL_FRACTION),
			})
		end
	end
	local carrying = nil
	if state.carrying ~= nil then
		local record = BrainrotData.getBrainrot(state.carrying)
		if record ~= nil then

		end

		income = BrainrotData.getTotalIncome(player),
